Valid unique values for this field include 'Africa', 'Antarctica', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'North America', 'Oceania', 'South America', and 'Seven seas (open ocean)'. A successful classification must show at least 5 distinct colors on the map corresponding to these values. The final project must be saved as 'continent_categories.gvsproj' and the export as 'continent_map.png'.
